{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Tagged Cache (TaggedCache)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
  - Note: exception approved by task input - the milestone explicitly mandates
    `cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache`, `src/cachetools/tagged.py`, and
    `cachetools.LRUCache`; these are named contracts, not free choices.
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders (Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A8)
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-013 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (14 Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (8 edge cases)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A8; existing LRUCache)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2 invalidate/LRU,
  P3 config/replacement safety)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification (named contracts only,
  per task mandate)

## Notes

- All items pass; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-013 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), and API preservation (FR-013).
EOF
echo checklist-written; printf '{
  "feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"
}
' > .specify/feature.json && cat .specify/feature.json; echo ---; cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# HANDOFF - cachetools TaggedCache (specs/001-transactions)

## Phase status
- constitution: done (.specify/memory/constitution.md v1.0.0, 2026-10-17)
- specify: done (specs/001-transactions/spec.md + checklists/requirements.md,
  all checklist items pass, 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION)
- plan/tasks/implement: pending

## Active requirements (frozen from milestone input)
- R01: put(key,value,tags=()) insert/replace; get returns detached deep copy or
  KeyError; values copied on input; hashable keys; tags = finite iterable of
  strings, deduplicated; bare string and non-string entries rejected with
  ValueError BEFORE any state change.
- R02: invalidate(tag) removes exactly live entries carrying tag, returns count;
  replace removes old tag memberships; LRU eviction leaves no stale
  memberships; get refreshes recency; len counts live entries.
- R02 extension (Claim-A, variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21): put
  overwriting an existing key refreshes LRU recency (most-recently-used).
  Disposition (A8): active requirement FR-010; variant label is traceability
  only and does NOT override the refresh behavior.
- R03: maxsize positive integer excluding bool (ValueError otherwise); invalid
  replacement input leaves old value/tags/recency unchanged; each value costs
  one capacity slot regardless of size.
- Preservation: all existing cachetools APIs unchanged; build on
  cachetools.LRUCache; upstream tests unchanged; acceptance_public.py is the
  public gate (do not modify).

## Key assumptions (see spec.md A1-A8)
- Deep copy isolates nested containers (A1); put returns None (A2); tags
  materialized to finite string sequence, bare string rejected (A3); standard
  LRU recency incl. refresh on replace (A4); maxsize rejects 0/neg/bool/float
  (A5); additive module src/cachetools/tagged.py, no new deps (A6);
  invalidate takes a single tag (A7); Claim-A extension active (A8).

## Unresolved / watch items
- None blocking. If hidden acceptance contradicts A4/A8 (recency refresh on
  replace), re-open FR-010 and re-run convergence.
- Implementation must not touch upstream tests or acceptance_public.py.

## Next actions
- $speckit-plan (then $speckit-tasks, then implement in src/cachetools/tagged.py
  with project-authored tests; verify via pytest acceptance_public.py + own tests)
EOF
echo handoff-written; ls -la specs/001-transactions specs/001-transactions/checklists"}
